chapter: Hollywood and the break with Thornhill
title: Louis Armstrong tribute and clips from the film
summary: A 1973 California tribute showed the clips and she recalls reappearing with Louis through a paper screen.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: But I was out in California in 1973, and they did the Louie Armstrong -- I guess you'd call it a festival or jubilee or something -- but they played -- they showed all these film clips, and they did a lot of things that Louie did.
They had Barney Bigard and Johnny Green and Joe Bushkin. It was a big affair.
And they showed the clips from the movie. They've never shown Going Places on the late show. I've been sort of hoping that they would so I could see it, but they haven't.
That same year -- well after we made the movie, Louie and I appeared at the Cotton Club. In fact, we were the last act that played the downtown
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

And it was the -- I guess that -- I'm a little confused now as to the date -- but I thought it was '39 when we went in there -- say, September '39, because the show usually started September and ran through the winter and ran through the spring.

And they showed -- they used a paper screen, and they showed the scene from Going Places with Louis and I -- Louis and his grooming outfit; you know, the white jacket, and I had on the maid uniform; and we were singing 'Jeepers Creepers.'
Yes. And it had a certain --
Well, we came through this paper screen in the identical costumes -- that was the opening of the show, which I thought was quite imaginative then.
